Data visualization¶

In [242]:
diagnosis_counts = data['diagnosis'].value_counts()

labels = ['良性(B)', '恶性(M)']

plt.figure(figsize=(6,6))
plt.pie(
    diagnosis_counts,
    labels=labels,
    autopct='%1.1f%%',
    startangle=90
)

plt.title('乳腺癌诊断类别占比饼图-武文博')
plt.show()
In [243]:
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 6))
ax = sns.countplot(data=data, x='diagnosis')

total = len(data)

for p in ax.patches:
    count = int(p.get_height())
    percentage = 100 * count / total

    ax.annotate(
        f'{count}\n{percentage:.1f}%',
        (p.get_x() + p.get_width()/2, count),
        ha='center',
        va='bottom'
    )

plt.title('诊断类别数量柱状图-武文博')
plt.xlabel('诊断类型')
plt.ylabel('样本数量')
plt.show()
